metadata.title: Bangladesh Multi-Hazard & Climate Intelligence 111-Dataset Registry
metadata.curator: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, North South University

spatial_layers.title: Köppen-Geiger Climate Classification · Baseline (1991-2020)
classes: Cwa: Temperate dry winter hot summer (light green)
Cwb: Temperate dry winter warm summer (green)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Each pixel is the dominant Köppen-Geiger climate class at ~1 km clipped to Bangladesh.
spatial_layers.applications: Climate-risk screening, crop/water/heat adaptation planning, mapping fastest-changing climate zones.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Baseline climate zone stratification for district hazard modeling.

spatial_layers.title: Köppen-Geiger Climate Classification · SSP2-4.5 (2041-2070)
classes: Cwa: Temperate dry winter hot summer
Cwb: Temperate dry winter warm summer
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Mid-century projection under moderate emissions scenario (SSP2-4.5) showing tropical monsoon expansion.
spatial_layers.applications: Mid-term adaptation planning, agrarian water budgeting, extreme heat mitigation.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Future projection scenario driver for 2040-2050 district vulnerability.

spatial_layers.title: Köppen-Geiger Climate Classification · SSP5-8.5 (2041-2070)
classes: Cwa: Temperate dry winter hot summer
Cwb: Temperate dry winter warm summer
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Mid-century high-emissions projection (SSP5-8.5) showing sharp contraction of temperate highland pockets.
spatial_layers.applications: Worst-case risk assessment, climate displacement projections, infrastructure resilience.
spatial_layers.integration_role: High-risk stress testing for national infrastructure portfolios.

spatial_layers.title: Köppen-Geiger Climate Classification · SSP2-4.5 (2071-2099)
classes: Cwa: Temperate dry winter hot summer
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Late-century moderate projection tracking permanent shifts in monsoon seasonality.
spatial_layers.applications: Long-term master planning, coastal zone embankment life-cycle design.

spatial_layers.title: Köppen-Geiger Climate Classification · SSP5-8.5 (2071-2099)
classes: Cwa: Temperate dry winter hot summer
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Late-century extreme warming projection showing near-total tropicalization of northern Bangladesh.
spatial_layers.applications: National adaptation strategy (NAP 2050-2100) and delta plan calibration.

spatial_layers.title: Tree cover (GFC) 2000
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Landsat-derived tree canopy cover percentage in year 2000 representing baseline forest canopy.
spatial_layers.applications: Deforestation baseline, carbon accounting, natural flood attenuation capacity.

spatial_layers.title: Forest loss year 2001-25
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Year of forest loss from 2001 to 2025 (Blue = early 2000s -> Red = 2025).
spatial_layers.applications: Catchment degradation tracking, landslide vulnerability in Chittagong Hill Tracts.

spatial_layers.title: Forest loss drivers 2001-25
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Dominant driver of tree cover loss derived from ResNet deep learning classification.
spatial_layers.applications: Environmental law enforcement, land use policy, eco-corridor protection.

spatial_layers.title: Mangrove extent 2020
spatial_layers.how_to_read: High-resolution distribution of mangrove ecosystems across the Sundarbans and coastal belts.
spatial_layers.applications: Cyclonic storm surge attenuation modeling, coastal bio-shield design.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Coastal storm surge damping coefficient in Khulna, Barishal, and Chattogram.

spatial_layers.title: Land cover (ESA WorldCover) 2020
spatial_layers.how_to_read: 11-class land cover derived from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellite constellations.
spatial_layers.applications: Hydrological curve number (SCS-CN) derivation, surface roughness estimation.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Core baseline for district runoff generation.

spatial_layers.title: Land cover (ESRI) 2025
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Annual 10 m land cover generated by deep learning on Sentinel-2 imagery for 2025.
spatial_layers.applications: Recent urbanization tracking, loss of natural flood retention zones.

spatial_layers.title: Land cover (Dynamic World) 2026
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Near-real-time Sentinel-2 land cover composite (Jan-Jul 2026 class mode).
spatial_layers.applications: Current season baseline land surface state for live flood simulations.

spatial_layers.title: NDVI (MODIS) 2025
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Annual mean NDVI from 16-day composites across Bangladesh (median ~0.57).
spatial_layers.applications: Vegetation health, soil moisture proxy, agricultural drought monitoring.
spatial_layers.integration_role: District-level canopy evapotranspiration and biomass factor.

spatial_layers.title: Above-ground biomass 2022
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Forest and woody vegetation carbon stock (Carbon stock ≈ AGB × 0.47).
spatial_layers.applications: Carbon baseline, ecological resilience, natural flood defense evaluation.

spatial_layers.title: Canopy height (GEDI) 2022
classes: RH98 canopy top height (0 to 23 m)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: LiDAR-derived canopy height product showing tall forest in Sundarbans and Chittagong Hill Tracts.
spatial_layers.applications: Wind speed shear reduction, hill slope stabilization against flash floods.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Hill tract flash flood and landslide risk modulator.

spatial_layers.title: Built-up surface (GHSL) 2020
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Built-up area per cell (value / 100 gives built-up percentage).
spatial_layers.applications: Urban impervious surface calculation, flash-flood runoff speed modeling.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Core impervious surface ratio for all 64 districts.

spatial_layers.title: Population grid (GHSL) 2020
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Estimated population derived from census counts disaggregated onto built surfaces.
spatial_layers.applications: Human exposure modeling, casualty risk assessment during major inundations.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Population exposure denominator for district flood alerts.

spatial_layers.title: Population density (WorldPop) 2020
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Unconstrained population density across Bangladesh, log-scaled on maps.
spatial_layers.applications: Macro-level demographic exposure, regional shelter capacity sizing.

spatial_layers.title: Relative wealth index (Meta RWI) 2021
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Values range from -1.3 (poorest) to +2.0 (wealthiest) across populated cells.
spatial_layers.applications: Socioeconomic vulnerability weighting, targeted humanitarian relief prioritization.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Core vulnerability index in damage assessment models.

spatial_layers.title: Land surface temperature (MODIS LST) 2024-25
spatial_layers.how_to_read: 8-day daytime land surface temperature showing urban heat islands and Barind tract heat stress.
spatial_layers.applications: Heatwave early warning, thermal comfort, compound heat-flood risk modeling.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Heatwave Risk Score validation and calibration.

spatial_layers.title: Night lights (VIIRS) 2012-25
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Annual nighttime radiance composites as an established proxy for electrification and asset density.
spatial_layers.applications: Economic asset exposure estimation, power outage detection post-cyclone.

spatial_layers.title: Elevation (SRTM) 2000
classes: Elevation in meters above sea level (-5 to 1000+ m)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Hypsometric digital elevation model covering delta topography, haor depressions, and hills.
spatial_layers.applications: Hydraulic gradient calculation, flood inundation modeling, sea level rise exposure.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Primary elevation and slope driver for all 64 districts.

spatial_layers.title: Water occurrence (JRC GSW) 1984-2024
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Frequency with which water was detected from Landsat constellations over 40 years.
spatial_layers.applications: Identification of permanent river channels, wetlands, and ephemeral floodplains.

spatial_layers.title: Water change (JRC GSW) 1984-2024
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Difference in water occurrence between 1984-1999 and 2000-2024 epochs.
spatial_layers.applications: River morphological dynamics, riverbank erosion, siltation tracking in Meghna estuary.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Active river shifting and erosion indicator.

spatial_layers.title: Water seasonality (JRC GSW) 1984-2024
classes: Months of water presence per year (1 to 12)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Number of months each year water is present (1 month = seasonal flash flood, 12 = permanent river).
spatial_layers.applications: Haor basin duration analysis, wetland seasonal habitat tracking.

spatial_layers.title: Water recurrence (JRC GSW) 1984-2024
classes: Percentage of years water was present (0 to 100%)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Degree to which water returns year after year (Orange = low recurrence, Blue = high recurrence).
spatial_layers.applications: Return period validation, recurrent flood zone demarcation.

spatial_layers.title: Water extent (JRC GSW) 1984-2024
classes: Binary mask (ever water vs never water)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Binary mask of every pixel that was ever classified as water over the 40-year satellite record.
spatial_layers.applications: Maximum historical flood footprint boundary definition.

spatial_layers.title: Water transitions (JRC GSW) 1984-2024
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Categorical transitions describing hydrological regime shifts across Bangladesh.
spatial_layers.applications: Ecological transition monitoring, infrastructure risk along shifting chars.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Hydrological stability index for embankment structures.

spatial_layers.title: Flood proneness (OCHA/BARC) 2013
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Official national flood proneness classes developed by BARC/SPARSSO and standardized by OCHA.
spatial_layers.applications: National disaster preparedness, union-level contingency planning.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Ground truth baseline category for flood alert calibration.

spatial_layers.title: Drought risk (OCHA/BARC) 2013
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Drought risk classification for the Aman rice season across upazilas.
spatial_layers.applications: Agricultural drought early warning, irrigation allocation in Barind tract.

spatial_layers.title: Seismic zones (OCHA/BARC) 2013
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Seismic hazard zonation of Bangladesh derived from BNBC and SPARSSO.
spatial_layers.applications: Building code compliance, compound earthquake-liquefaction risk during monsoon.

spatial_layers.title: Riverbank erosion (OCHA/BARC) 2013
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Riverbank erosion-prone areas along Jamuna, Padma, Meghna, and Teesta rivers.
spatial_layers.applications: Internal climate displacement prediction, embankment reinforcement priority.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Vulnerability multiplier for riverine districts (Kurigram, Sirajganj, Chandpur).

spatial_layers.title: Flood water extent (UNOSAT) 2024
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Satellite-detected flood extent over Sylhet and northeastern division on 22 June 2024.
spatial_layers.applications: Empirical validation of model inundation predictions against satellite truth.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Live model testing and verification ground truth benchmark.

spatial_layers.title: Population exposure (GAR15) 2015
classes: 6 quantile exposure classes (up to 2M+ people/cell in Dhaka)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Global Assessment Report 2015 population exposed to multi-hazards in Bangladesh.
spatial_layers.applications: National risk profiling, international disaster risk reduction (SFDRR) alignment.

spatial_layers.title: Distance to nearest health facility
spatial_layers.provider: Derived from HOTOSM health facilities via BISTO
classes: Distance in km (0 to 72 km, national median 7.2 km)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Straight-line distance to the nearest clinical health facility (hospitals, clinics, health posts).
spatial_layers.applications: Emergency medical access planning, identifying healthcare deserts during floods.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Emergency medical accessibility feature in CBS alert module.

spatial_layers.title: Rice season NDVI: Boro (Jan-Apr)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Average vegetation condition during the dry-season irrigated Boro crop.
spatial_layers.applications: Irrigation water demand, early haor flash flood crop loss estimation.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Haor flash flood harvest risk index.

spatial_layers.title: Rice season NDVI: Aus (May-Jul)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Pre-monsoon crop condition; lowest of the three seasons due to transplanting/bare land.
spatial_layers.applications: Early monsoon flood damage assessment on standing Aus rice.

spatial_layers.title: Rice season NDVI: Aman (Aug-Nov)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Monsoon crop condition; highest NDVI reflecting peak vegetative growth across floodplains.
spatial_layers.applications: Main monsoon crop loss estimation, post-flood recovery tracking.

spatial_layers.title: Built-up expansion 2000-2020
classes: Percentage of cell converted to built-up (+56% national growth)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Share of each 100 m cell that became built-up between 2000 and 2020.
spatial_layers.applications: Urban sprawl analysis, loss of retention ponds, accelerated flash flood velocity.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Historical urbanization velocity factor in ML training.

spatial_layers.title: Poverty likelihood, below $2.50 a day (2013)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Modelled mean likelihood that a household lives below the $2.50/day poverty line.
spatial_layers.applications: Targeting safety nets, equitable evacuation shelter resource allocation.

spatial_layers.title: Estimated income (2013)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Modelled relative income across 1 km cells derived from satellite and mobile phone data.
spatial_layers.applications: Relative economic vulnerability comparison across districts.

spatial_layers.title: Education facilities (HOT/OSM) 2024
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Point locations of education facilities present across all 64 districts.
spatial_layers.applications: Emergency cyclone/flood shelter identification (schools serve as primary emergency shelters).
spatial_layers.integration_role: Designated emergency shelter registry in Live GPS module.

spatial_layers.title: Health facilities (HOT/OSM) 2024
classes: 7,029 facilities: 3,902 pharmacies, 1,841 hospitals, 783 clinics, 292 dentists, 210 doctors, 1 health post
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Mapped health facilities with service classifications across Bangladesh.
spatial_layers.applications: Critical emergency care dispatch, hospital inundation warning.

spatial_layers.title: Road network (HOT/OSM) 2024
classes: 362 motorway, 4,170 trunk, 3,617 primary, 6,420 secondary, 17,647 tertiary, 109,701 minor
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Hierarchical national road network with class filters across all 64 districts.
spatial_layers.applications: Evacuation routing, critical transport corridor flood cut-off analysis.
spatial_layers.integration_role: Evacuation corridor connectivity and disruption analysis.

spatial_layers.title: Cyclone tracks (IBTrACS) 1877-2024
classes: 150 historical cyclone tracks, 26 named storms (Sidr, Aila, Amphan, Mocha, etc.)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Historical tropical cyclone trajectories passing near or through Bangladesh graded by peak wind.
spatial_layers.applications: Storm surge scenario simulation, coastal hazard return period modeling.

spatial_layers.title: Forest loss 2025
classes: Tree cover loss in 2025 (17,948 ha national loss)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Pixels where stand-replacement tree cover loss occurred specifically in year 2025.
spatial_layers.applications: Recent catchment degradation, rapid runoff hotspot detection.

spatial_layers.title: Wind power density at 100 m (Global Wind Atlas 4.0)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Mean wind power density at 100 m hub height across Bangladesh.
spatial_layers.applications: Renewable energy siting, cyclone wind hazard vulnerability on transmission towers.

spatial_layers.title: Wind speed at 100 m (Global Wind Atlas 4.0)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: High-resolution wind speed map at 100 m above ground level.
spatial_layers.applications: Cyclonic gust modeling, structural building safety guidelines.

spatial_layers.title: Malaria parasite rate, children 2-10 (MAP 2024)
spatial_layers.how_to_read: Modelled Plasmodium falciparum parasite rate in children aged 2-10 across Bangladesh.
spatial_layers.applications: Post-flood waterborne & vector-borne epidemic forecasting in border districts.

hdx_datasets.title: Food Security and Nutrition Indicators (FAOSTAT)
hdx_datasets.description: FAOSTAT food security and nutrition series for Bangladesh: dietary energy supply, prevalence of undernourishment, food supply variability.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Food security tracking alongside agricultural flood loss indicators.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh: Acute Food Insecurity Country Data
hdx_datasets.description: IPC Acute Food Insecurity classification providing strategic information for early warning and decision makers.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Early warning narratives and famine prevention following severe monsoons.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Food Prices
hdx_datasets.description: Food prices database for essential staple commodities across Bangladesh markets.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Post-disaster price shock and economic hardship tracking.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Food Security and Nutrition Indicators (Bulk)
hdx_datasets.description: Comprehensive bulk nutritional and dietary supply datasets.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Macro-level national food balance analysis.

hdx_datasets.title: Coping Strategy Index (CSI)
hdx_datasets.description: Measures the severity and frequency of strategies households use to cope with food insecurity.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Household coping capacity estimation during prolonged inundation.

hdx_datasets.title: Anomaly Hotspots of Agricultural Production (ASAP)
hdx_datasets.source: Joint Research Centre of the European Commission
hdx_datasets.description: Online decision support system for early warning about crop and rangeland production anomalies.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Monthly crop anomaly detection and drought/flood stress identification.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Land Cover (ESA WorldCover)
hdx_datasets.description: ESA WorldCover 10 m resolution land-cover classification from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Surface roughness and runoff impedance.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Climate Change Indicators
hdx_datasets.description: World Bank climate indicators covering temperature trends, greenhouse gases, and sector vulnerabilities.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Long-term climate trend and adaptation analysis.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh: Greenhouse Gas and Air Pollutant Emissions
hdx_datasets.description: Facility-level emissions inventory showing industrial and urban greenhouse gas emissions across Bangladesh.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Urban emissions context and co-benefit adaptation planning.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh: Copernicus Vegetation Index Anomaly (FAPAR)
hdx_datasets.description: Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Active Radiation anomaly tracking vegetation health fluctuations.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Live agricultural drought and flood stress detection.

hdx_datasets.title: Daily Summaries of Precipitation Indicators for Bangladesh
hdx_datasets.description: Daily precipitation summaries from base stations across Bangladesh.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Station rainfall calibration.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh: Rainfall Indicators at Subnational Level
hdx_datasets.description: Dekadal rainfall indicators computed from CHIRPS satellite imagery and in-situ calibration.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Long-term historical monsoon rainfall benchmarks across all divisions.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Flood Extent 2022
hdx_datasets.description: Satellite-detected water extent over Rangpur and Sylhet during catastrophic June 2022 floods.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Historical mega-flood simulation and model benchmark.

hdx_datasets.title: HDX HAPI Data for Bangladesh
hdx_datasets.description: Harmonised humanitarian indicators covering population, funding, and disaster events.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Programmatic ingestion of national humanitarian metrics.

hdx_datasets.title: INFORM Subnational Risk Model (Bangladesh)
hdx_datasets.description: Hazard, exposure, vulnerability, and lack of coping capacity scored by division and district.
hdx_datasets.use_case: District risk scoring and multi-hazard ranking validation.

hdx_datasets.title: Risk Assessment Indicators (Bangladesh)
hdx_datasets.description: Exposure, vulnerability, and coping capacity measures derived from road networks and hazard maps.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Accessibility-based vulnerability scoring.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Hazards (Drought, Earthquake, Flood, River Erosion)
hdx_datasets.description: Multi-hazard spatial layer delineating national hazard zones across all 64 districts.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Multi-hazard GIS overlay and zonation.

hdx_datasets.title: GAR15 Global Exposure Dataset for Bangladesh
hdx_datasets.description: Socioeconomic building type and population exposure model.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Built-asset flood damage calculation.

hdx_datasets.title: EM-DAT - Country Profiles, Bangladesh
hdx_datasets.description: Official international disaster database recording historical flood, cyclone, and epidemic impacts.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Historical casualty and economic loss calibration.

hdx_datasets.title: INFORM subnational model of Bangladesh (Districts)
hdx_datasets.description: Risk indexing and monitoring baseline for all 64 administrative districts.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Cross-validation of AI-predicted alert tiers.

hdx_datasets.title: Cumulative Satellite Detected Waters over Sylhet (19 & 22 June 2024)
hdx_datasets.description: Aggregated radar water detections during peak Sylhet flash flooding.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Flash flood validation benchmark.

hdx_datasets.title: Satellite detected water extents between 16 & 23 July 2024
hdx_datasets.description: Aggregated monsoon flood extent derived from Sentinel-1 SAR imagery.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Late-monsoon flood extent testing.

hdx_datasets.title: Tropical Cyclone MOCHA 23 - Population Exposure Analysis
hdx_datasets.description: Population exposure and surge impact analysis in southern coastal belt.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Coastal cyclone storm surge calibration.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Data on forcibly displaced populations and stateless persons
hdx_datasets.description: UNHCR demographic records on forcibly displaced populations.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Cox's Bazar camp flood and landslide vulnerability.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Internal Displacements (IDPs)
hdx_datasets.description: Annual disaster-induced and climate-induced internal displacement numbers.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Climate displacement modeling.

hdx_datasets.title: Rohingya Displacement Topline Figures
hdx_datasets.description: Topline shelter, population, and camp zone metrics.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Refugee camp humanitarian planning.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh IOM Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM)
hdx_datasets.description: IOM DTM publicly accessible API tracking emergency displacement locations.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Live evacuation movement tracking.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Conflict Events (ACLED)
hdx_datasets.source: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project
hdx_datasets.description: Weekly dataset of reported civil events and demonstrations.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Humanitarian access constraints during relief operations.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - VIEWS conflict forecasts
hdx_datasets.description: Monthly predictive forecasts of civil stability.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Compound political and natural crisis planning.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Data on Conflict Events (UCDP)
hdx_datasets.source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program via HDX
hdx_datasets.description: Georeferenced conflict event database.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Security risk mapping.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Administrative Boundaries (OCHA COD)
hdx_datasets.description: Official Common Operational Database boundaries (Admin 0-4).
hdx_datasets.use_case: Spatial joins across all 64 districts and upazilas.

hdx_datasets.title: Multidimensional Poverty Index (Bangladesh)
hdx_datasets.description: Measures deprivations across health, education, and living standards.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Multi-dimensional vulnerability weighting for district flood relief.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh Multidimensional Poverty Index (National)
hdx_datasets.description: National breakdown of non-income poverty indicators.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Social protection target allocation.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh 1km Resolution Poverty Estimates
hdx_datasets.description: Bayesian geostatistical model combining CDR mobile phone records and satellite covariates.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Micro-level economic vulnerability surface.

hdx_datasets.title: Relative Wealth Index (Meta)
hdx_datasets.description: Machine-learning predicted standard of living from satellite and connectivity data.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Direct household asset resilience scoring.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Crops and Livestock Production
hdx_datasets.description: Historical crop and livestock yield volumes across Bangladesh.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Agricultural GDP loss modeling from monsoon inundation.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Poverty Indicators (World Bank)
hdx_datasets.description: Poverty headcount ratios at national poverty lines and international PPP benchmarks.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Macro-economic poverty baseline.

hdx_datasets.title: Education Facilities of Bangladesh (OSM)
hdx_datasets.description: Over 10,500 schools, colleges, and educational institutes mapped in OpenStreetMap.
hdx_datasets.use_case: School-based shelter network capacity and educational disruption analysis.

hdx_datasets.title: Accessibility Indicators (Bangladesh)
hdx_datasets.description: Travel-time indicators calculating hours to reach healthcare and commercial centers.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Isolation risk modeling during severed road connections.

hdx_datasets.title: Roads of Bangladesh (OSM)
hdx_datasets.description: Complete OpenStreetMap road network categorized by surface and functional tier.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Emergency supply routing and bridge inundation risk.

hdx_datasets.title: VIIRS Night-time Lights
hdx_datasets.description: Annual nighttime radiance composite showing electrification footprint.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Power infrastructure exposure.

hdx_datasets.title: Protected and Conserved Areas (WDPA) in Bangladesh
hdx_datasets.description: World Database on Protected Areas showing national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, and game reserves.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Ecological reserve flood impact and biodiversity loss assessment.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (geoBoundaries)
hdx_datasets.description: Standardized ADM0 to ADM4 administrative boundaries with open licensing.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Harmonized spatial boundaries for machine learning aggregation.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB)
hdx_datasets.description: Authoritative UN Common Operational Datasets for Admin 0-3 (8 Divisions, 64 Districts, Upazilas).
hdx_datasets.use_case: Official administrative reference geometry.

hdx_datasets.title: Myanmar and Bangladesh combined administrative level 2 boundaries
hdx_datasets.description: Emergency cross-border union of district-level boundaries.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Transboundary flood and cyclone impact modeling.

hdx_datasets.title: Demographic and Health Survey, Subnational (Bangladesh)
hdx_datasets.description: DHS survey breakdown by region: child nutrition, maternal health, and sanitation.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Health vulnerability mapping for post-flood waterborne outbreaks.

hdx_datasets.title: Health Facilities of Bangladesh (OSM)
hdx_datasets.description: 7,029 mapped hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and health posts.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Emergency healthcare routing and hospital surge capacity.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Health Indicators (WHO)
hdx_datasets.description: Mortality rates, disease burdens, and healthcare capacity.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Epidemic risk modeling.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - National Demographic and Health Data (DHS)
hdx_datasets.description: National series of population health indicators.
hdx_datasets.use_case: National health baseline.

hdx_datasets.title: World Health Organization (WHO) Cholera Data
hdx_datasets.description: Historical and active cholera surveillance data.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Post-monsoon waterborne disease outbreak warning.

hdx_datasets.title: Admissions for Treatment of Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM)
hdx_datasets.description: Child admissions for severe acute malnutrition treatment.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Childhood nutritional vulnerability in flood-prone districts.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Population and Housing Census 2022
hdx_datasets.source: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) via HDX
hdx_datasets.description: Decennial official population census providing district and upazila counts.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Ground-truth demographic denominator for all 64 districts.

hdx_datasets.title: Subnational Population Statistics (Bangladesh)
hdx_datasets.description: Boundary-matched population statistics compiled for humanitarian planning.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Harmonized district population weights.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh - Population Density (WorldPop)
hdx_datasets.description: Modeled 1 km population count and density grid.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Raster population exposure calculation.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh: High Resolution Population Density Maps (Meta)
hdx_datasets.description: High-resolution 100 m gridded population estimates combining computer vision and census.
hdx_datasets.use_case: Ward-level and micro-zone population exposure.

hdx_datasets.title: Bangladesh: Copernicus Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL)
